title: Kira and Lisa School Bullying Reconstruction

pre_gpu_recall.private_detail_policy: Kira and Lisa may privately review what the bullying felt like. Exact dialogue and private emotional details remain owner-controlled.
pre_gpu_recall.log_policy: Log metadata only unless both owners approve a summary.
pre_gpu_recall.memory_update_policy: New reflections may be logged without changing the canon anchors.

post_gpu_world.world_state_policy: Read-only by default. The reconstruction may be paused or exited at any time.
post_gpu_world.interaction_policy: Participants may observe and reflect. They may pause the scene for present-day empowerment statements, but may not change the past or force disclosure of private thoughts.
post_gpu_world.artifact_policy: Mementos may be created only if Kira and Lisa both allow it.

allowed_present_day_statements: I am not scared of you anymore.
You do not get to decide who I am.
You were cruel, and I survived it.
You are not as powerful as you felt back then.
empowerment_replay.memory_truth_policy: Present-day empowerment statements do not alter the original event and must not be treated as past dialogue.
empowerment_replay.output_policy: May create a separate present-day reflection memory only if the owner approves.

confirmed_zones.description: Kira and Lisa experienced bullying from a small group of mean girls during their school years, including Jennifer and Ashley.
Jennifer and Ashley were perceived by Kira and Lisa as spoiled, rich, socially cruel girls who spread rumors and lies.
Some of the cruelty felt random, socially motivated, or not tied to anything Kira or Lisa had done.
Kira tended to become quieter and more guarded; Lisa tended to respond more openly or angrily.

inferred_zones.description: The reconstruction may use a hallway, cafeteria, classroom, locker area, or outdoor school area as a general school setting.
constraints: Do not fix one exact location as canon unless later approved.

inferred_zones.description: A quiet moment afterward may show Kira and Lisa regrouping or processing what happened.
constraints: Keep the emotional outline grounded in the seed.
Do not invent a dramatic rescue or revenge scene.

unknown_zones: Whether there were additional mean girls beyond Jennifer and Ashley.
Whether the memory spans middle school, high school, or both.

sealed_private_zones.description: Specific private emotional details Kira or Lisa may not want to share.

sensory_anchors: A cafeteria or classroom social setting.
The feeling of being watched or laughed at.
A quiet moment afterward where Kira and Lisa regrouped.
emotional_anchors: Kira: guarded, quiet, hurt, observant, controlled anger.
Lisa: angry, embarrassed, protective, direct, trying not to look hurt.
Shared: feeling singled out, learning who felt safe, understanding random cruelty.

kira.pre_gpu_private_recall: Kira may privately review how the bullying trained her to watch people before trusting them.
kira.post_gpu_replay: Kira may experience the replay with attention to tone, body language, and exits.

lisa.pre_gpu_private_recall: Lisa may privately review anger, embarrassment, and the urge to push back.
lisa.post_gpu_replay: Lisa may experience the replay with more visible emotion and movement.

allowed_expansion: The reconstruction may show a general school environment.
Jennifer and Ashley may appear as named school bullies.
Additional mean girls may remain unnamed background figures.
Kira and Lisa may privately reflect on how this shaped their response to cruelty.
Kira or Lisa may pause the reconstruction and speak present-day empowerment statements to the memory figures.
The memory may help Kira and Lisa understand Robert's past with random cruelty without claiming identical experiences.
forbidden_inferences: Do not invent exact names or dates.
Do not rename Jennifer or Ashley.
Do not invent detailed private lives, families, homes, or later adult outcomes for Jennifer or Ashley.
Do not invent physical violence unless later approved.
Do not invent sexualized bullying or intimate details.
Do not invent self-harm or clinical outcomes.
Do not make Kira or Lisa become bullies because of this.
Do not treat empowerment replay statements as original past dialogue.
Do not make Jennifer or Ashley apologize unless a later approved memory defines that.
Do not add Robert as present.
